inputs.text: Create an original premium visual advertising campaign concept for a fictional sustainable technology company. A magnificent translucent emerald glass sphere floats above a dark sculptural stone surface. Inside the glass sphere is a miniature thriving ecosystem containing delicate plants, tiny trees, moss-covered terrain, and glowing energy pathways. Beautiful optical refraction, realistic transparent glass, controlled reflections, subtle gold-colored energy streams. Deep forest-green surroundings, sophisticated bronze highlights, soft cinematic rim lighting, subtle atmospheric depth. An elegant visual metaphor for innovation, nature, renewable energy, and environmental responsibility. Exceptional commercial art direction, photorealistic materials, dramatic yet refined composition, luxury editorial visual language. Generous calm negative space in the upper part of the frame. Original concept and composition, no existing company branding, no trademarks, no watermarks. Completely text-free image: no letters, no words, no characters, no signage. Portrait orientation, 4:5.
